title: SPOT DNA Extraction from 142mm A/E 1µm Filters
author: Yi-Chun Yeh
materials: After re‐suspension, immediately quantify using PICO Green (Invitrogen).

steps.title: Prepare Equipment and Reagents
steps.instruction: Set up the necessary hardware and prepare the 2X lysis buffer.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 70°C water bath (microwave water to heat faster and cover with foil).
Prepare a razor blade, forceps, and a metal slab; keep the metal slab in the fridge before use and place ice packs under it during use to minimize decay.
Prepare 200 ml of 2X lysis buffer by mixing: 32 ml 0.25 M EDTA (pH 8), 20 ml 1 M Tris (pH 8, Trizma base), 8 ml 2.5 M NaCl, 20 ml 10% SDS (w/v), and 120 ml autoclaved Milli-Q water.
Prepare 0.5 mm zirconia/silica beads in 0.5 ml tubes.

steps.title: Initial Filter Lysis
steps.instruction: Extract DNA from the filter using a two-stage lysis process.

substeps.instruction: Thaw 142mm A/E filters briefly, cut into pieces on the cold metal slab, and place into a 50 ml falcon tube.
Add 6.2 ml of 2X lysis buffer and 500 µl of 0.5 mm zirconia/silica beads.
Perform a cycle of bead-beating (vortex) for 1 min followed by incubation in a 70°C water bath for 7 min; repeat this cycle 4 times.
Centrifuge at 3901 rcf in a swinging bucket rotor (#4250) on a Beckman Allegra at 20°C for 2 min.
Transfer the lysate to an Oak Ridge tube labeled 'a'.
Add another 6.2 ml of 2X lysis buffer to the filter remaining in the 50 ml falcon tube and repeat the bead-beating/heating cycle (4 times) to increase yield.
Transfer this second lysate and the filter to a new Oak Ridge tube labeled 'b' using a 20 ml syringe to squeeze out as much lysate as possible.
If tube 'b' contains more than 6.2 ml, pour lysate from 'b' into 'a' to equalize the volumes.

steps.title: CTAB Precipitation
steps.instruction: Purify the lysate using CTAB and salt precipitation.

substeps.instruction: To the 6.2 ml lysate, add 1 ml of 10% CTAB and 2.8 ml of 2.5 M NaCl.
Incubate in a 70°C water bath for 10 min.
Add 28 ml of ice-cold 100% EtOH (200 proof, molecular grade) and 3 ml of 10.5 M ammonium acetate.
Store at -20°C overnight.

steps.title: First DNA Pelleting and Drying
steps.instruction: Recover the DNA pellet from the CTAB mixture.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 24,000 g / 13,000 rpm in a swinging bucket rotor (Beckman Avanti JE or Beckman Sorvall) at 4°C for 2 hrs.
Gently pour out the supernatant (store in labeled 50 ml falcon tubes at -20°C) and dry the pellet upside-down in a fume hood for at least 2 hours.

steps.title: Phenol-Chloroform Extraction
steps.instruction: Clean the DNA using a series of organic extractions.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 500 µl sterile 1X TE buffer for 2 hours at 37°C.
Transfer to 2 ml non-LoBind tubes.
Add 500 µl phenol (bottom layer, pH 8.0 equilibrated, <6 months old). Mix by gentle inversion.
Remove the phenol (bottom layer), leaving the interface behind. Store phenol layer in labeled 2ml non-Lobind tubes at -20°C.
Add 300 µl phenol and 300 µl chloroform:Isoamyl alcohol to the aqueous phase.
Spin for 2 min at 12,000 rpm (13,000xg), mix by gentle inversion, and spin again for 2 min at 12,000 rpm (13,000xg).
Remove the bottom layer, leaving the interface behind. Store bottom layer in labeled 2ml non-Lobind tubes at -20°C.
Add 500 µl chloroform:Isoamyl alcohol, mix by gentle inversion, and spin for 2 min at 12,000 rpm (13,000xg).
Transfer the top aqueous layer (DNA) to a new 2ml non-LoBind tube, leaving the interface behind.

steps.title: Final DNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Concentrate and purify the DNA for final storage.

substeps.instruction: Add 1375 µl ice-cold 100% EtOH (200 proof, molecular grade) and 125 µl 10.5M ammonium acetate.
Mix by inversion 5-10 times and store at -20°C overnight.
Centrifuge at 20,000 g on a Beckman Avanti JE at 4°C for 2 hrs.
Decant the supernatant (store in labeled tubes at -20°C) and air-dry the pellet in a bio-safety hood for 2 hrs.

steps.title: Final Resuspension and Pooling
steps.instruction: Resuspend the DNA and organize the final stocks.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in sterile 1X TE buffer: use 50 µl for surface and DCM samples, or 30 µl for 150m, 500m, and 890m samples.
Vortex and quick spin twice, then incubate at 40°C for 1 hr.
If both 'a' and 'b' samples provided good yields, pool them together.
Transfer half of the total pooled volume to a 1.5 ml LoBind tube for archiving and the other half to a 1.5 ml LoBind tube for working stock.
